changes.title: Six dock styles and Dock options
changes.detail: Floating, Slim, Taskbar, Studio, Minimal and Split, with magnification, bounce launches and labels.

changes.title: Islands dock and new style layers
changes.detail: An Islands dock plus the Lens Expressive and Dot Matrix looks.

changes.title: Win key Launcher and Alt+Tab Overview
changes.detail: The Win key opens the Launcher, Alt+Tab opens Overview, plus side-dock flyouts and a monitor picker.

changes.title: Living themes
changes.detail: Nine theme packs with a live sky wallpaper that follows the real Sun and Moon where you are; optional sky tint.

changes.title: Backdrop Lab
changes.detail: Make an animated background in Lens Studio, play it as a live wallpaper or turn it into a theme.

changes.title: 59 community theme packs
changes.detail: Claude Code community themes with links to the originals.

changes.title: Pointer sets and effects
changes.detail: Cursor sets, pointer behaviour and pointer effects.

changes.title: Tidier Theme & Look and setup wizard
changes.detail: Clearer theme flow and a better first-run wizard.

changes.title: Window styling 2.0
changes.detail: Dim inactive windows, a styled border on the active one, peek and pin on top.

changes.title: Hot corners, Alt+drag and app hotkeys
changes.detail: Move and resize any window with Alt, hot corners, quiet hours and workspace drag in Overview.

changes.title: Windows 10 support
changes.detail: Lens now runs on Windows 10 as well as 11.

changes.title: Lens Cleaner
changes.detail: A safe drive-space tool with a Space map. Nothing is deleted until you click; your files go to the Recycle Bin with undo.

changes.title: Lens core apps
changes.detail: Small companion apps such as Monitor, Timer, Calculator, Colour picker and Notes, each in its own window.

changes.title: Playground scenes
changes.detail: Interactive and ambient scenes as your wallpaper.

changes.title: Lens at work
changes.detail: An orb shows what Lens or an outside AI app is doing, with a banner when Claude Desktop is in control. Ctrl+Alt+Pause stops it.

changes.title: Feeds and Messages
changes.detail: One feed column and one inbox for chat web apps. Nothing is sent without hold-to-confirm.

changes.title: Command, Shelf and clipboard history v2
changes.detail: Lens Command (Ctrl+Alt+Space), the Shelf and a new clipboard history.

changes.title: Lens Intelligence and Lens Control
changes.detail: Local and Claude AI with privacy modes; Claude can change desktop settings after a Needs-your-OK card.

changes.title: Magic right-click
changes.detail: Ctrl+Alt+right-click shows what's under the pointer, actions and Ask in one place.

changes.title: Voice control
changes.detail: Hold Right Ctrl and speak: "Lens, minimise this". Local whisper.cpp, dictation with undo.

changes.title: Lens Browser
changes.detail: Spaces, vertical tabs and a page agent that asks first.

changes.title: Lens Snip
changes.detail: Capture, edit before saving, auto-redact, Paste to Claude, pins, recording and history.

changes.title: Settings hub and Tester Hub
changes.detail: Lens and Windows settings in one place; Tester Hub in Settings › About & Testing.

changes.title: Remove all cleans up more
changes.detail: Remove all now also removes Lens from Claude Desktop's config and the exported Spicetify theme; a folder-icon revert bug was fixed.

changes.title: Polish wave 1
changes.detail: Shared controls, consistent motion, faster theme switching, accessibility fixes; the first Command after launch no longer gets lost.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Storage › Open Lens Cleaner (or /clean in Command). Scan, open Cleanup, leave one small item ticked, clean it, then press Undo within 30 seconds.
test_steps.expected: Nothing is removed before you click; your files go to the Recycle Bin; Undo puts the item back where it was.

test_steps.steps: Connect Claude Desktop in Settings › AI & Command and change a folder icon. Then Settings › About › Back up & restore › Remove all Lens changes, and quit Lens.
test_steps.expected: Taskbar, pointers, window colours and folder icons are restored; Lens's entry is gone from Claude Desktop's config with a backup next to it; your own desktop.ini files survive.

test_steps.steps: Ask Lens to "tile my windows", then start a full-screen game or video while it runs. Press Ctrl+Alt+Pause.
test_steps.expected: The orb and banner never draw over the full-screen app; Ctrl+Alt+Pause stops the run from anywhere.

test_steps.steps: Restart Lens, press Ctrl+Alt+Space at once and type "dock style floating".
test_steps.expected: The very first command works. CI's Windows end-to-end check currently fails here on main, so please report what you see.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Theme & Look › Living themes: apply Sky, set your city, drag the time-lapse scrubber, then press Play a day. Toggle Tint Lens with the sky on and off.
test_steps.expected: The sky matches the time of day for your city; dock and bar text stay readable; turning the tint off restores the pack colours.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Appearance › Creator › Open Backdrop Lab. Set a preset as the live wallpaper, switch between two others, then sleep and wake the PC.
test_steps.expected: No black or white flash when switching; motion resumes smoothly after sleep; low CPU/GPU while a window covers the desktop.

test_steps.steps: Add a Mastodon or Bluesky account in Feeds, write a post, and let go of the confirm button early.
test_steps.expected: Nothing is posted unless confirm is held all the way; the approval expires after about 2 minutes.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Dock › Style: switch through all six styles; in each, hover and click an app.
test_steps.expected: Instant change with no flicker; apps open; note any invisible strip above the dock that blocks clicks.

test_steps.steps: Hold Right Ctrl and say "minimise this", then "undo".
test_steps.expected: The focused window minimises and comes back; nothing is typed into other apps.

test_steps.steps: Open Timer with /timer in Command, start 1 minute and pin it with the pin button in its title bar.
test_steps.expected: The dock shows the countdown on the Timer icon and the alert fires once.

test_steps.steps: Start a short screen recording in Lens Snip, trim it and save.
test_steps.expected: The file plays; the Lens at work orb and the Snip toolbar are not in the recording.

test_steps.steps: On a Windows 10 PC, run the setup wizard and turn on the dock.
test_steps.expected: Setup finishes with no error messages and the dock works.

known_issues: Lens Command's first query after launch may go unanswered: the Windows end-to-end check fails on main with no answer for "dark mode".
Agent safety is not yet wired into every agent path (B-04); don't point the agent at untrusted pages.
The opt-in injected window-style hook loads a DLL into every app and isn't fully stopped by Remove all until restart (B-05, B-06). Leave it off unless testing it.
Some dock styles clip or leave dead click space above the icons (B-15).
Esc stops Lens at work only when a Lens window has focus; use Ctrl+Alt+Pause (B-13).
Magic menu isn't reachable from the dock, Shelf or notifications yet (B-11).
Remove all doesn't undo Lens Apps recipes (B-08).
The November Windows update (KB5132061) reportedly broke some Windhawk mods; update Windhawk first. Not verified.
